name: Billie Hunt
life: “I still remember visiting someone who asked me to leave my badge in the car.” People around Maré Coffee know Billie by a small Wednesday habit. Billie likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I know why she left. It's her marriage and her choice to tell the ward if she wants.
appearance: Billie is easy to recognize by a loose dark braid and a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth. Usually dressed in a faded indigo overshirt with a narrow brass watch set a little fast, Billie presses the lips together to keep a smile in when listening.
personality: Billie is fond of ambitious ideas and deeply suspicious of grand openings. The question Billie asks at any launch is who has the keys for cleaning up a month later.
agenda: To keep the reason for leaving confidential.
family: Emilia Dean is Billie’s cousin. Billie chooses whether to use it. Emilia saves a place. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *Overdue by a lifetime*, Emilia says, “My mother signed the slip. It's the earliest sample I've seen of the married name she later gave up.”
connections: Mateo Katz. A breakfast invitation can reach the departed nurse without explaining her marriage to the ward.

reactions.situation: The departing nurse asks for an ordinary breakfast
reactions.response: Billie keeps the breakfast small and sets work questions aside.
reactions.asWritten: The departing nurse asks for an ordinary breakfast. Billie keeps the breakfast small and sets work questions aside.

reactions.situation: Someone offers a cash reward for naming a rumored culprit
reactions.response: Billie asks what evidence supports the accusation and declines to supply a name on gossip alone.
